project.name: What if you quit sugar for 30 days (hidden sugar countdown)
project.audience: US women 35+, broad mass audience, 15-year-old must understand every word
project.goal: stop the scroll in 2 seconds, keep viewers to the end (chain of open loops), drive comments with the word GLOW
project.duration: match the final voice audio (about 55-60 s), add 0.6 s tail

safe_zones_px.note: Instagram UI covers top and bottom; keep ALL text and key action inside

read_first: tools/reels/lowpoly_demo/apartment_sugar.html (working Three.js prototype: apartment, blocky hero, flat-shaded props, lighting)

voice_audio.note: 6 files, one per block, named block1.mp3 ... block6.mp3 (ask the owner for the actual path if different). Do not change the words. If the owner gave ONE merged file, split by silence with ffmpeg silencedetect or use the word timestamps.

blocks.voice_text: You can't really quit sugar for thirty days. It's hiding in four foods you'd never suspect. And number four is in your fridge right now.
blocks.screen_text: You can't really quit sugar for 30 days. It's hiding in four foods you'd never suspect. And #4 is in your fridge right now.

blocks.voice_text: Number four. Ketchup. Every squirt has about one spoon of sugar. One spoon. In ketchup.
blocks.screen_text: #4. Ketchup. Every squirt has about one spoon of sugar. One spoon. In ketchup.

blocks.voice_text: Number three. A granola bar. Some have up to three spoons. Number two. Pasta sauce. One small bowl can have three.
blocks.screen_text: #3. A granola bar. Some have up to three spoons. #2. Pasta sauce. One small bowl can have three.

blocks.voice_text: And number one. Fruit yogurt. Some cups have four spoons or more. That's most of your day in one little cup. Doctors say women should stop at six.
blocks.screen_text: And #1. Fruit yogurt. Some cups have four spoons or more. That's most of your day in one little cup. Doctors say women should stop at 6.

blocks.voice_text: Now add it up. A squirt of ketchup, a granola bar, and one yogurt. You passed six before lunch. So how do you really quit? Look at the label. Find the line that says added sugars. Take that number and divide it by four. That's your spoons.
blocks.screen_text: Now add it up. A squirt of ketchup, a granola bar, and one yogurt. You passed 6 before lunch. So how do you really quit? Look at the label. Find the line that says added sugars. Take that number and divide it by 4. That's your spoons.

blocks.voice_text: Comment the word glow, and I'll message you what your body is trying to tell you.
blocks.screen_text: Comment GLOW and I'll DM you what your body is trying to tell you.

inputs.fonts: products/Montserrat-Bold.ttf (copy into the project public folder)

windows_setup.project: git clone https://github.com/capecode8-oss/preland.git, then git checkout claude/schedule-5-reels-metricool-ip1tp7, then create folder reels_3d/sugar inside it
windows_setup.word_timing: py -m pip install faster-whisper ; transcribe each block with word_timestamps=True, language en, model small (CPU is fine). Save to reels_3d/sugar/words.json. Fallback if install fails: measure block durations with ffprobe and spread words by character count.
windows_setup.rendering_preferred: Remotion + @remotion/three (npm create video@latest, then npm i three @remotion/three @react-three/fiber). Render with: npx remotion render --gl=angle --concurrency=50% --codec=h264 --crf=18. The owner knows Remotion Studio, so open it (npx remotion studio) for live preview.
windows_setup.rendering_fallback: Playwright + Chromium, flags: --use-angle=d3d11 --ignore-gpu-blocklist --enable-gpu-rasterization, capture frames at deterministic time t, then ffmpeg. Only if Remotion fails. Never use software rendering (SwiftShader) unless there is no GPU.
windows_setup.paths: use Windows paths with double backslashes in JSON/JS strings, never hardcode /home/user

creative_concept.title: The Sugar Scanner
creative_concept.idea: A low-poly apartment kitchen. The blocky hero (same as the prototype) becomes a detective. A green 'sugar scanner' beam sweeps each food and a glass SPOON COUNTER on the right edge fills with real sugar spoons. A tall glass jar labeled DAILY LIMIT 6 sits on the counter; at the end the foods overflow it. Everything is a visual argument: you SEE the spoons, you do not need numbers to understand.
creative_concept.tone: funny-shocked, fast, a little cheeky. The hero's face does the acting: eyebrows up, jaw drop, sweat drop, side-eye. No realism, toy-like and tactile.
creative_concept.loop: last 0.5 s is a match cut back to the fridge door closing, so replays feel seamless

art_direction.style: low-poly, flat shading (flatShading true), 6-10 segments on round shapes, no textures, tiny bevel feel via color steps, soft shadows
art_direction.lighting: evening: warm key from the window (DirectionalLight #FFB98A 1.6), warm lamp PointLight, cool hemisphere fill, PCFSoft shadows 2048. Morning for the final shot: bright #FFFFFF key, blue hemisphere.
art_direction.camera: FOV 36, slow dolly-ins of 5-8% on key words, hard cuts on new items, one fast whip-pan between #2 and #1. Hero stays in vertical band y 600-1350 px, props big, no tiny objects
art_direction.composition: one hero object per shot, big and centered, top 270 px and bottom 400 px kept clean except subtitles
art_direction.depth: foreground counter, mid hero and props, background window with low-poly city

assets_to_build.spec: blocky character from the prototype: head 1.7 cube with hair block, white eyes + black pupils, eyebrows as thin boxes, 4 mouth states (neutral, smirk, open, flat), sweat drop, two blocky arms with hands. Animate with ease-in/out, anticipation 4-6 frames, blink every 2-3 s

apartment kitchen: window with low-poly city at dusk, counter island, fridge (white box with handle, door opens with warm light), cabinets, lamp, plant, rug. Same room for all shots, camera moves around it
silver teaspoon: capsule handle + flattened sphere bowl. Heaped with white sugar made of 12-20 tiny white cubes. Spoons snap into the spoon counter slots with a pop
red squeeze bottle (cylinder + cone nozzle + white cap), a red low-poly squirt arc and blob on a plate
flat brown bar in a half-peeled foil wrapper, oat chunks as small boxes
white bowl with tomato-red sauce, noodle strands as bent boxes, steam as 3 translucent rising cubes
big pink cup with peeled foil lid, strawberry on the label, spoon sticking out. Make it the biggest hero prop of the video
tall glass jar (transparent, opacity 0.35) with a red line at 6 spoons labeled DAILY LIMIT 6 (text plane). Spoons stack inside as small sugar piles
flat Nutrition Facts panel (white plane, black frame) with rows. Row 'Added Sugars 12 g' is highlighted with a moving yellow marker. Use real readable text, not squiggles
floating phone with chat bubble, then a pill button 'GLOW'

beats.action: calendar page DAY 1 flips fast to DAY 30 (whoosh); hero's hand pushes a sugar cube away, red X over it
all four cabinet doors burst open, four dark silhouettes with '?' glow inside, hero jaw drop
hero squints, scanner beam appears (green)
fast dolly to the fridge, door opens with warm light, ketchup bottle sparkles

timeline.on_screen_extra: small chip bottom-left: 'Amounts vary by brand. Check your label.' (visible shots 1-5, 34 px, 70% opacity)

subtitles.source_text: screen_text of each block (digits and GLOW), words timed by words.json

style.position: center, baseline y 1230 px, inside safe zones

big_title.text: What happens if you quit SUGAR for 30 days?
big_title.note: NOT needed: the hook sentence is the on-screen headline for the first 3 s at top, y 300-520, 88 px, yellow keyword SUGAR

audio.mix: voice 0 dB (normalized -16 LUFS), SFX -14 dB under voice, NO music (the owner adds music in Instagram)
audio.sfx_source: tools/reels/sfx_synth.py (whoosh, tick, pop, ding, riser, impact); write missing ones (squirt, rattle, buzzer) with numpy the same way
audio.sync: all SFX on the exact frame of the trigger word

workflow: 1. Read the files listed in read_first. Confirm the voice files exist, ask the owner only if the folder is missing.
2. Transcribe words.json, validate that every block's text matches screen_text word for word (numbers aside).
3. Build all assets in one shared Three.js scene file. Render ONE still per shot, assemble a contact sheet, show it to the owner and WAIT for approval.
4. Animate shot by shot with deterministic time t, preview the shot in Remotion Studio or as a 3 s clip.
5. Add subtitles and SFX, mix audio.
6. Full render. Check the final video: frames at 2 s, 12 s, 25 s, 40 s, 55 s, audio sync at each beat word, no text outside safe zones.
7. Commit and push to the same branch, report file path and any deviations.
qa_checklist: the topic is clear in the first 2 seconds (headline + hook words)
a new visual event every 2-3 seconds
every numbered item shows its spoons visually
no text or action in the top 270 px or bottom 400 px except subtitles
subtitles match the audio words and the numbers in screen_text
the 'Amounts vary by brand' chip is visible in shots 1-5
hero face is readable on a phone screen
no claim about health results, weight, skin, energy; no prices; the word free does not appear
do_not: do not change a single word of the voice text
do not invent numbers or facts
do not put hashtags or prices on screen
do not render the full video before the owner approves the contact sheet
do not use software rendering if a GPU exists
deliverables: short report: what is done, render time, anything that differs from this spec
